newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Daily Variety - May 30.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Daily Variety - May 30.

text.p: The following stories appeared in Friday's Daily Variety:

* Viacom Inc Chairman Sumner Redstone was in the hot seat as shareholders forced him to defend his leadership, the company's management and its strategy for dealing with its troubled Blockbuster video unit.
* Westinghouse Electric Corp Chairman Michael Jordan apologized to CBS affiliates for the timing of last week's corporate shakeup.

* MGM has purchased the fact-based comedy of "Molly," which is about a man who has to take care of his sister when she is released from an institution. MGM is owned by Kirk Kerkorian and Australia's Seven Network Ltd.
* Ann Daly, who was president of Walt Disney Co's Buena Vista Home Video unit, has been named head of DreamWorks SKG's feature animation division.
* Nora Ephron and her sister Delia will write a partially autobiographical project for Sony Corp's Columbia Pictures.
